candidate_select.integration_gap: ot_hdc_v41x_sel_cand exports block indices only (out_blk; u_sel's out_val is not brought out) and its front end overwrites the pinned block's max with +inf, so as built the merge records' values (and the true max of ranks 0-2's pinned blocks) are not available from the unit; the final here takes them from the golden scores
candidate_select.pin_issue: Do not carry per-rank artificial +inf to global merge; true maxima required.

shared_compute_comparison.model: T_dedicated = startup + max(N*68/B_mem,N*4096/C_idx,N/R_selector) + scorer_tail + selector_tail + merge; T_shared additionally maxes on mutable-ingress BW and subtracts concurrently occupied shared MAC capacity, plus switches and movement.
shared_compute_comparison.reuse_opportunity: Index scoring can use a reusable exact FP4 dot engine only if chunk32 scales, head weighting/reduction and BF16 rounding match. Selector is integer/compare/memory work and not replaced by more MACs.
shared_compute_comparison.remote_penalty: Each full scan rank sends 17,825,792B at L20; at 1TB/s extra route floor is17.826us if serialized, or max bottleneck if streamed. Near-HBM returns only selected score/ID records.
shared_compute_comparison.selection_reservation: Keep local top512 per shard; global top512 of union is exact with total ordering. Candidate block top2048 is additional branch at L20, requires true block maxima and global newest pin.
